exact_single_axiom_all_paper.description: Exact data-free single-axiom recovery across the 75 cases reported in Appendix D.1 / Table 6.

cases_completed.description: Number of cases whose method artifact reports normal completion rather than timeout or failure; reported for diagnostics because missing cases already count against rate denominators.

cases_total.description: Number of cases in this experiment slice denominator.

degenerate_candidate_count.description: Number of cases where derivability is achieved only through a degenerate boundary explanation; reported for diagnostics, with the normalized nondegenerate rate used for scoring.

derivable_candidate_count.description: Number of cases with at least one nondegenerate candidate that symbolically derives the target relation.

derivable_candidate_rate.description: Fraction of cases with at least one nondegenerate derivability-certified candidate.

nondegenerate_candidate_rate.description: Fraction of cases not solved through degenerate boundary explanations.

success_count.description: Number of cases whose accepted candidates satisfy the experiment success criterion.

success_rate.description: Fraction of cases in the slice that satisfy the experiment success criterion.

success_signal.description: Success rate with a tiny solved-case coverage tie-breaker used only as the primary metric for saturated split sub-experiments.
